question: Find the Urban MahaNet GR of 28 September 2018.
gold_answer: One GR with English and Marathi copies; later amended 10-04-2019

gold_grs_detail.title: Implementation of Urban MahaNet project  and Delivery of E-Governance Services
Implementation of Urban MahaNet project  and Delivery of E-Governance Services

product.answer: The Urban MahaNet GR of 28 September 2018 is code 201809281811031811, titled 'Implementation of Urban MahaNet project and Delivery of E-Governance Services'. It was amended on 10-04-2019 by GR 201904101409364011, which waived ROW fees across the state, allowed Smart Poles installation, and extended the TSP contract to 5 years.
